name: Viral hepatitides
rawContent:
# Viral hepatitides: Core Condition Reference

## Overview
Viral hepatitides are liver inflammations caused by hepatotropic viruses (A, B, C, D, E) with acute and/or chronic disease patterns.

overview.definition: Viral hepatitides are liver inflammations caused by hepatotropic viruses (A, B, C, D, E) with acute and/or chronic disease patterns.
overview.epidemiology: Global burden significant; transmission differs by virus type.
overview.pathophysiology: Viral replication and immune-mediated hepatocyte injury cause transaminitis and jaundice.

signs: Stigmata of chronic liver disease in chronic infection

firstLine: Viral serology/PCR panel based on risk factors
specialistTests: Hepatology assessment and fibrosis staging for chronic HBV/HCV

diagnosis.criteria: Compatible clinical syndrome with specific viral serology/PCR confirmation.

firstLine: Infection prevention counselling and contact/public health actions
Monitor INR/mental state for liver failure
secondLine: Antivirals for selected indications (virus-specific) after specialist input

monitoring: Long-term antiviral care pathways for chronic HBV/HCV and cirrhosis/HCC surveillance where indicated

content.prognosis: Depends on virus and chronicity; HAV/HEV often self-limiting, HBV/HCV may progress to cirrhosis/HCC.
content.foundationDoctorRole: Identify likely viral patterns, arrange initial workup, provide safety-netting, and involve hepatology/public health appropriately.
content.escalation: Urgent escalation for rising INR, encephalopathy, hypoglycaemia, severe jaundice, or haemodynamic instability.
content.keySafetyConsiderations: Check pregnancy status and occupational/public-health implications; avoid hepatotoxic medications.
